meta.description: Repayments received on the business date.
meta.sql:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE demo_dwd.dwd_lending_repayment_di PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT r.repay_txn_no,
       MAX(r.loan_no) AS loan_no,
       MAX(l.customer_id) AS customer_id,
       SUM(CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS repay_amt,
       MAX(r.paid_time) AS repay_time
FROM demo_ods.ods_repay_txn_di r
JOIN demo_dwd.dwd_lending_loan_df l ON r.loan_no = l.loan_no AND l.dt = '${bizdate}'
WHERE r.dt = '${bizdate}'
GROUP BY r.repay_txn_no
